name: Deploy package docs to Cloudflare Pages

# Builds the public documentation site for the @ourworldindata/grapher npm
# package (packageDocs/) — including the API reference generated by TypeDoc
# and the chart-config schema reference generated from the grapher schema —
# and deploys it to the owid-grapher-docs Cloudflare Pages project. The site
# is served at https://docs.owid.io/projects/grapher/; the path routing
# lives in owid/owid-docs (_worker.js).

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
    paths:
      - "packageDocs/**"
      - "packages/@ourworldindata/**"
      - "devTools/schema/generate-schema-docs.ts"
      - "yarn.lock"
      - ".github/workflows/deploy-docs-cf.yml"
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      - "packageDocs/**"
      - "packages/@ourworldindata/**"
      - "devTools/schema/generate-schema-docs.ts"
      - "yarn.lock"
      - ".github/workflows/deploy-docs-cf.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: deploy-docs-cf-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - name: Clone repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-node-yarn-deps

      - name: Build package and generate API & schema reference
        working-directory: packages/@ourworldindata/grapher
        run: |
          yarn build
          yarn buildDocsApi
          yarn buildDocsSchema

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7.1.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v10.3.3
        with:
          # Caching is disabled in this deploy workflow to avoid cache-poisoning
          # of the published docs artifact (zizmor cache-poisoning audit).
          enable-cache: false

      - name: Install docs dependencies
        working-directory: packageDocs
        run: uv sync

      - name: Override site_url for the Cloudflare build
        working-directory: packageDocs
        run: |
          sed -i 's|^site_url = .*|site_url = "https://docs.owid.io/projects/grapher/"|' zensical.toml

      - name: Build docs
        working-directory: packageDocs
        run: uv run zensical build --clean

      - name: Stage build under /projects/grapher/
        run: |
          mkdir -p staging/projects/grapher
          cp -a packageDocs/site/. staging/projects/grapher/
          # On the production domain the site only exists under
          # /projects/grapher/, but preview deployments are visited at the
          # bare *.pages.dev root — redirect that to the actual site.
          echo '<meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0; url=/projects/grapher/">' > staging/index.html

      - name: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages
        # Fork and Dependabot PRs don't get the Cloudflare secrets, so the
        # deploy would fail — build-only for those, deploy for trusted refs.
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v4.1.3
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN_DOCS }}
          accountId: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          command: >-
            pages deploy staging
            --project-name=owid-grapher-docs
            --branch=${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
